title: Count Vowel Strings in Ranges
summary: Given an array of strings and a set of queries, count the number of strings starting and ending with a vowel within the specified range for each query.
statement: Given an array of strings and a set of queries, count the number of strings starting and ending with a vowel within the specified range for each query. Return an array of results corresponding to each query.
constraints: A vowel word starts and ends with a lowercase vowel.
Each query [left,right] is an inclusive word-index range.
Return the qualifying word count for every query.
hints: Convert each word to one when both boundary letters are vowels, otherwise zero.
Build a prefix sum with a leading zero.
For inclusive [left,right], subtract prefix[left] from prefix[right+1].
Prefix differences contain exactly the indicator values in each query range, so queries become constant-time.
editorial: Prefix differences contain exactly the indicator values in each query range, so queries become constant-time.

tests.explanation: Prefix differences give counts two, three, and zero.
All three one-letter vowel words qualify.
